info.name: Execute a GraphQL query or mutation

items.docs: Executes a single GraphQL operation against Plain's API. The request body carries a GraphQL `query` string (which may contain a query or a mutation), an optional `variables` object, and an optional `operationName`. Mutations return their result and a typed `error` field in the GraphQL response data; transport- and schema-level problems are returned in the top-level `errors` array. Always returns HTTP 200 for well-formed GraphQL requests, including those whose operation produced a GraphQL error.
